title: Hawkeye 360 searching for 1.6 GHz at interesting places

tellings.quote: 1.6 GHz at interesting places I am certain has been looked at by Hawkeye 360

plain: A company called Hawkeye 360, which picks up radio signals from space, has surely looked for signals at a radio frequency of 1.6 gigahertz at "interesting places," according to Bob Maguire, a former contractor for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. Maguire says he is "certain" of it but gives no source, and he raises it because a signal at that frequency could point to something unusual going on at those spots.
